title: LLMs and Cultural Values: the Impact of Prompt Language and Explicit Cultural Framing

bias_targets.methodology: Probing LLMs with multiple-choice questions from the World Values Survey (WVS) and Hofstede Values Survey Module (VSM) using explicit cultural personas, and comparing the models' value alignments against actual human survey data across 11 countries.
Translating the survey prompts into 11 different languages to evaluate whether the language of the prompt implicitly alters the cultural values and policy preferences exhibited by the models.

Analyzing LLM responses to WVS questions regarding contentious social, ethical, and economic issues (e.g., homosexuality, abortion, environmental protection) to identify systematic skews toward progressive, left-leaning, or secular-rational viewpoints compared to global human baselines.
